Backend Software Engineer

Full-time

About the role
You will design and build backend services for our logistics platform and work closely with product and data teams.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and maintain REST APIs used by web and mobile clients.
- Write unit and integration tests and take part in code reviews.
- Improve the performance and reliability of services running on AWS.

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional experience with Java or Kotlin.
- Strong knowledge of Spring Boot and REST API design.
- Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Good understanding of data structures and algorithms.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Nice to have

- Familiarity with Kafka is a plus.
- Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Jenkins).
